title: Copying a rendering response preserves cookies in both web stacks
summary: Rebuilding a rendering response retained cookies, including two currencies with different paths, at both HTTP boundaries.

change.description: RenderingResponse.from copies cookies when rebuilding a functional MVC or WebFlux response.

notes: Both a servlet ModelAndView and a resolving reactive View receive the model. The caller also decodes Set-Cookie response fields and compares value/path multiplicity.
